entry.notes: representation gap lone-surrogate of the js table (registry/gaps/js.toml): @stellar/stellar-sdk xdr string<> as string (UTF-16 code units) or Uint8Array. a javascript string can hold a lone surrogate that UTF-8 cannot encode, and the bytes ED A0 80 (U+D800 in CESU-8) are not UTF-8. reading them gives a Uint8Array whose property key is "237,160,128"; writing a lone surrogate gives the bytes of U+FFFD with no error. nativeToScVal("\uD800") writes the string bytes EF BF BD in 17.2.1 and 17.4.0 without an error, which 17.4.0 documents on XdrString. as a map key, 17.2.1 merges the bytes ED A0 80 with the string "237,160,128"; 17.3.0 and 17.4.0 throw
